issue_context.title: slow memory leak may be in kubelet podworkers.isWorking
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please use this template while reporting a bug and provide as much info as possible. Not doing so may result in your bug not being addressed in a timely manner. Thanks!

If the matter is security related, please disclose it privately via https://kubernetes.io/security/
-->

#### What happened:

As the p.isWorking won't be cleared while pod was deleted, so while creating or deleting pods repeatedly, length of p.isWorking keep increasing


```
I0610 00:56:22.686625   12730 pod_workers.go:240] p.isWorking length 8
I0610 00:56:27.686615   12730 pod_workers.go:240] p.isWorking length 8

I0610 01:01:41.686553   12730 pod_workers.go:240] p.isWorking length 13
I0610 01:01:42.686687   12730 pod_workers.go:240] p.isWorking length 13
I0610 01:01:48.686530   12730 pod_workers.go:240] p.isWorking length 13


I0610 01:03:00.003440   12730 pod_workers.go:240] p.isWorking length 18


I0610 01:03:55.331554   12730 pod_workers.go:240] p.isWorking length 23
I0610 01:03:55.343556   12730 pod_workers.go:240] p.isWorking length 23
```

#### What you expected to happen:

length of p.isWorking does not keep increasing

#### How to reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible):
 
creating or deleting pods repeatedly

#### Anything else we need to know?:
